"""Large search for a zero-partition structure using the fast VE."""
import sys, random, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def z_of(paths):
    agg = ref.aggregate([(tuple(p), 1) for p in paths], set())
    _l,_r,final = ref.peel_naive(agg)
    core = sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
    if not core: return None, core, final
    mm = len(core)
    if mm > 9: return None, core, final
    vi = {e:i for i,e in enumerate(core)}
    fa = final
    occ = m._occurrences(list(fa.items()), vi, mm)
    scopes=[]
    for e in range(mm):
        ctx=set()
        for (lk,rk) in occ[e]:
            if lk[0] in (1,2): ctx.add(lk[1])
            if rk[0] in (1,2): ctx.add(rk[1])
        scopes.append(tuple(sorted(ctx|{e})))
    factors = m._tables(occ, scopes, mm)
    order = list(range(mm))
    z, marg = m._eliminate(factors, order)
    return z, core, final

rng = random.Random(12345)
zeros = 0; checked = 0
for t in range(120000):
    n = rng.randint(3, 6)
    pool = list(range(1, n+1))
    paths = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 7)):
        k = rng.randint(2, n)
        p = rng.sample(pool, k)
        paths.append(p)
    z, core, final = z_of(paths)
    if z is None: continue
    checked += 1
    if z == 0:
        zeros += 1
        print('ZERO!', paths, core)
        if zeros >= 3: break
print('checked', checked, 'zeros', zeros)
